## Execution tips

- When grasping the burger package, contact relatively flat areas on opposite sides of its body, avoiding rounded corners and protruding paper edges. Confirm the fingers are on opposite sides before closing, avoiding top-only contact or grasping a paper corner.
- Consider gripping flatter lower-middle sides of the fries carton, avoiding its opening and exposed fries. Match the opening to carton width and side clearances to reduce the risk of toppling it.
- During transport, keep the fries box opening facing up and both the objects' bottoms and fingertips high enough to clear the tray rim, avoiding tipping or slipping after catching the edge.
- Leave room for the fingers to open during placement and avoid hitting the tray edge or another item with the gripper. Release only after the item is supported by the tray to reduce dropping, rolling, or tipping.
